title: BlueScreens Equipment
description: Adds More Equipment And Weapons To Play With!
body:
# **Bluescreens Equipment**

## **Features**
**Adds 8 Features That Change The Game**
**Here Are 4**|
**The Hammer** On Impact, It Stuns Entitys For 4 Seconds
**The Ghast Griefer** A Cannon That Shoots FireBalls and Occasionally Jams
**The Caller**A Block That When Right Clicked, Sends A Meteorite Towards Its Position, Leaving A Massive Crater.
**The Electric Core** Is A Block That Summons Lightning Every 5 Seconds. If Shot It Will Charge up And Cause A Supernova 500x More Powerfull Than A TNT.
